visualReview.method: Direct visual inspection of the full-size Japanese and English captures of the Settings window: the Playback and timing group lists the transition walking, dialogue-only arrow keys and smooth dialogue scroll switches with no Performance area row, and the guide entry shows the booklet as of v0.3.54. The capture script also asserts that no Performance area row exists. The hidden state (no plan tool, no act motion, saved areas kept) is checked in Chromium and WebKit by tests/act-areas-hidden-browser.cjs.
visualReview.limits: Chromium captures of the bundled feature-test show at 1440x900; Safari, iPad and the Mac app not tested
